summary.text: Steve Bradley, listed by Ballotpedia as Steven Bradley, is a Republican state representative from Iowa House District 66 who is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as dentist.

paragraphs.text: Steve Bradley was born in Napa, California, and graduated from Western Dubuque High School.
He earned a doctorate in dental surgery from Marquette University in 1986.

Bradley's career includes working as a dentist and a flight instructor, and he has served as president of the Cascade Chamber of Commerce and the Iowa Dental Association, as chair of the Iowa Dental Board, and on the Finley Hospital Foundation Board.
Bradley won the Republican nomination and then the general election for Iowa House District 58 in 2020, defeating incumbent Andy McKean in November.
In 2022 he defeated incumbent Lee Hein in the Republican primary for the redrawn District 66 and won the general election over Tony Amsler, and in 2024 he won re-election over Andy McKean.
Ballotpedia lists his current term as beginning January 1, 2023, and ending January 1, 2027, and shows him assigned to the House Education, House Human Resources and Labor committees for 2025-2026.
In 2026 he advanced from the June 2 Republican primary and faces Democrat Matt English in the general election.
